question: What claim about the uniqueness of this knowledge is at stake in denying that anything equal to it will exist again?
premises: Knowledge equal to this exists by means of this.
There will not be such knowledge again.
There will not be such knowledge at all in that sense.
inference: No knowledge equal to this knowledge will come to be again.
uncertainties: The scope of time for this denial is not specified by this verse alone.
plain_english: No knowledge equal to this will be again, nor will it be.
